svg.text: The result is a name too.
The cursor is inside the table Sales, so it is preselected. Tables, named ranges and
query results are offered; the pivot follows them when rows are added.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Tools ▸ Pivot Table… (Ctrl+Alt+T). With the cursor in a table it is the preselected source, as in Excel.
The source is a name (table, named range or query result), never loose cells, so the pivot grows with it.
Place: a new sheet by default, as in Excel, or a cell on this sheet. The result can't land on cells that hold something.
Create gives an empty pivot with the field panel open (Pivot 1). The assistant makes the same one with the same command.
